datasets.name: hotpotqa-rag
notes: Answers come from the distractor split; retrieval gold comes from BEIR qrels. They join on the HotpotQA question id.
Corpus capped by a seeded reservoir sample with every gold paragraph forced in, so recall is bounded by the retriever, not by the sampling.
Multi-hop: a question needs two paragraphs, so gold-in-context@k here means 'at least one', which is a floor, not the full evidence.
